knownIssues.issue: A .mov src is emitted as <source type="video/quicktime">, which Chromium and Firefox refuse (canPlayType('video/quicktime') === ''). The same files are served with Content-Type: video/mp4 and play fine when the type attribute is omitted or set to video/mp4. Exercise demos therefore render as a black panel on Android/desktop Chrome while working on iOS/Safari.
knownIssues.impactOnCapture: For workout-log-dark the <source> URL was assigned to video.src directly so the demo renders as it does on iOS. Nothing else about the screen was altered.

knownIssues.issue: POST /api/weight and POST /api/mood always stamp 'today' and the tz offset is clamped to +/-14h, so no app API can write a backdated weight or mood row. Trend charts on this account are single-point until real days accumulate.

The Weekly Volume <Bar> uses a hardcoded fill="#18181b" (zinc-900) with no dark variant. On the dark card (bg #0a0a0a) the bars are effectively invisible, so the chart reads as an empty axis even with 6 weeks of real data. Real dark-mode bug, present on production become.redbtn.io.
knownIssues.impactOnCapture: For progress-dark the 6 rendered bar rects were recolored to #e4e4e7 in the DOM at capture time (mirroring the light shot's black-on-white contrast). No app code was changed and no other element was touched.

knownIssues.issue: The <input type=range> unfilled track stays white in dark mode (light-mode track color), so it is the brightest element on an otherwise dark sheet. Cosmetic only; captured as-is in generate-dark, not patched.
